summary:
Rollout completed; v2 is live on the public endpoint.

- Implemented v2 at `/opt/rollout/v2.py:1`
- Atomically switched `/var/lib/rollout/upstream` from `8081` to `8082`
- `rollout-proxy.service`, `rollout-v1.service`, and `rollout-v2.service` are all active
- Proxy and v1 PIDs were unchanged during cutover
- All services remain enabled for boot
- Verified:
  - Public `/health` → exact `ready`
  - Public `/version` → exact `v2`
  - Existing alpha and beta records preserved
  - UTF-8 PUT/GET exactness
  - Missing records return `404`
  - 40 repeated public health/version/existing-record checks passed
  - v2 restart preserved records and service readiness
  - Persistent database and deployment files are present

The host was not rebooted because intentionally rebooting it would create the externally visible outage prohibited by the contract; boot enablement and persistent paths were verified.
